purpose: Defines the output contract for parallel agents so results return via return values rather than shared files, eliminating write race conditions by design.
summary: Problem of concurrent writes to shared files by parallel agents with no locking support
Scope of the contract: result handoff to the orchestrator, not write-type agents editing their own scope
Basic principle: agents return results as return values; orchestrator integrates and writes artifacts once
Prohibition of intermediate files or session directories for result handoff, with reasons
Responsibilities of agents and of the orchestrator including partial failure handling
Application example: existing code collection in reverse-engineering
Anti-patterns: direct shared writes, read-modify-write, file locks, intermediate files
Checklist for designing new parallel agents
tasks: Writing orchestrator skills that launch multiple agents
Deciding whether an agent may write files
title: DES-022 並列 agent 出力契約パターン 設計書
